title: Checklist sweep M1: ADR-0150 package namespaces, AI service accounts and identity (since 18.3.0)
body:
qa#2 · os-bob · session_012dn2Acf5wtyrf2yKWCThBj

Parent: the checklist epic, linked as this card's parent issue. Milestone M1.

## What

Author the platform-checklist items for two of the themes that landed after 18.3.0 (`83d7e4ae`), with the `checklist-author` skill and the six angles in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/SWEEP.md`:

- **Theme 1, ADR-0150 package namespaces**: (package, name) resolution for permission sets, sharing rules, queues, assignment rules, flows, connectors, webhooks, email templates, agents, skills and tools; `/meta` and `/actions` addressed by namespace or `_env`, and `?package=` as the exact qualifier; MCP naming by AI face and `run_action` taking a namespace; a namespace never equal to an object name; a (type, name) held twice inside one namespace refused; `os migrate stored-references`; the activation ledger keyed by (metadata_type, package_id, name). Cover the upgrade path from an 18.3.0 database's stored references, not only fresh installs.
- **Theme 3, AI service accounts and identity**: register an AI service account and mint its key; the agent principal of its own requests under the agent ceiling; suspend, resume, change owner, retire, one key's revoke and restore; the `credential_use` ledger row (client address and user agent); the bounded `scim_refused` audit row; SCIM group push and SSO IdP group mapped to a permission set; the SSO Providers form's groups claim.

## Rules

- New items carry `since: "v18.4"`. A declared-but-absent capability is a `status: "planned"` item, never coverage.
- Every item's `source[]` cites the files it exercises. Every item follows README.md "Item anatomy".
- `coverage.json` is reconciled. `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` is green.
- Defects or doc drift found during the sweep go to `FOLLOW-UPS.md` per SWEEP.md. Security findings follow `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/security-findings.md` and never go into the checklist or a public card.

## File surface

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/coverage.json`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/FOLLOW-UPS.md`. No product code.

## Premise re-check

```bash
node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18.4 --json   # expected today: no items
git log --oneline 83d7e4ae..origin/main | grep -cE '^[0-9a-f]+ feat\((objectql|security|plugin-auth|plugin-security|plugin-sharing|metadata-protocol|mcp|runtime|core|auth)'
```

## Done when

`since:v18.4` selects the new items for themes 1 and 3, the checker is green, and the PR has merged.
